description: Migrate the remaining five hand-rolled agent-spec reads that are NOT name->model scans onto the hardened reader, preserving each caller's current failure semantics exactly (skip-and-continue everywhere here; a refused spec must degrade like an absent one). Sites: agent.py migrate_agent_specs (reads AND rewrites — the copy-out case _spec_path_is_safe warns about); dashboard/handlers/agents.py two glob-scan reads; dashboard/handlers/mcp.py three agents-dir scan reads. steps: src/kiro_crew/agent.py `migrate_agent_specs` (~2652-2673): this reads each spec, strips bookkeeping keys, and REWRITES it in place via `_atomic_json_write`. Replace `data = json.loads(spec_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))` + the `except (OSError, ValueError): continue` + `if not isinstance(data, dict): continue` with `data = _read_spec_capped(spec_path)` (the existing wrapper at ~2704 that calls _read_agent_spec) and `if data is None: continue`. CRITICAL — the rewrite path: _read_agent_spec refuses a symlink whose RESOLVED target is sensitive, but the copy-out hazard _spec_path_is_safe documents (following ANY symlink reads the target and writes a modified copy into the agents dir) is broader. Because this site writes back, guard the rewrite with the existing `_spec_path_is_safe(spec_path, agents_dir)` fence BEFORE reading/rewriting (agents_dir = kiro_agents_dir_path()), skipping (continue) any path that is a symlink, escapes the dir, or is sensitive — matching how the other rewrite paths (~2784, ~2836) already gate on _spec_path_is_safe. Net: read through the hardened reader AND keep the stricter no-symlink-at-all fence for the write. Preserve the `cleaned` counter, the name/stem fallback (`data.get('name') or spec_path.stem`), the per-file `_atomic_json_write` try/except OSError warning, and the return value.

src/kiro_crew/dashboard/handlers/agents.py `_namespaced_agent_file_exists` (~93-107): replace `data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))` inside the `glob('*--{agent_name}.json')` loop and its `except (OSError, ValueError): continue` with `data = _read_agent_spec(path)` + `if data is None: continue`, then keep the `if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get('name') == agent_name: return True` check (data is already a dict when non-None, but leaving the isinstance check is harmless; prefer `if data.get('name') == agent_name`). Import `_read_agent_spec` from kiro_crew.agent_discovery (add to the existing `from kiro_crew.agent_discovery import (...)` block that already pulls spec_model/spec_str). Preserve the outer `except OSError: return False` and the trailing `return False`.

src/kiro_crew/dashboard/handlers/agents.py delete/patch scan (~1565-1570): replace `data = json.loads(f.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))` inside `for f in kiro_agents_dir_path().glob('*.json')` with `data = _read_agent_spec(f)` + `if data is None: continue` placed BEFORE the `if data.get('name') == name or f.stem == name:` match. Preserve the surrounding try/except structure and all the delete/patch branch logic that follows the match unchanged (this is a large block — only the read line and the None-skip change).

src/kiro_crew/dashboard/handlers/mcp.py `_collect_server_rows` (~781-783): replace `spec = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))` inside `for path in sorted(agents_dir.glob('*.json'))` + `except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError): continue` + `if not isinstance(spec, dict): continue` with `spec = _read_agent_spec(path)` + `if spec is None: continue`. Add `_read_agent_spec` to the imports from kiro_crew.agent_discovery (or import agent_discovery and call ad._read_agent_spec — match whatever import style this module already uses; it imports kiro_agents_dir_path from kiro_crew.agent).

src/kiro_crew/dashboard/handlers/mcp.py `_launch_specs_for` (~2692-2694): same replacement pattern as the previous step (glob '*.json', read via _read_agent_spec, `if spec is None: continue`, drop the now-redundant `except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError)` and `isinstance` non-dict check). Preserve the `if name not in names` filtering and SimpleNamespace construction.

src/kiro_crew/dashboard/handlers/mcp.py third agents-dir scan (~2755-2760): same replacement pattern. Re-grep to confirm this is an agents-dir `*.json` spec read and NOT a `_GLOBAL_MCP_JSON` or `_installed_agent_config()` read (those are OUT OF SCOPE). Preserve surrounding logic and skip-and-continue semantics.
